Container.Name: Homelabarr - Frontend
Container.Overview: A beautiful, modern web interface for managing your home lab Docker containers. Homelabarr makes it easy to deploy and manage self-hosted applications with just a few clicks. [br] This is the frontend component of the Homelabarr stack. It is designed to be used with the Homelabarr Backend and Homelabarr Socket Proxy containers.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: home lab docker containers management gui web interface deploy
Container.Changes:
### 2026-11-04
Updated for Homelabarr 2.6: new ports and settings, secrets, a dedicated socket proxy, and plain-HTTP login on the LAN.
### 2025-02-02
Initial release
Container.Requires: Install all three Homelabarr templates: Socket Proxy, Backend and Frontend. Create their network once from the Unraid terminal: docker network create homelabarr

Config.Name: Allow plain HTTP
Config.Description: Set to true if you open Homelabarr at a plain http:// address on your LAN (the usual Unraid setup). Without it the browser drops the login cookie and you land back on the login screen. Set to false behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Backend address
Config.Description: Where the frontend reaches the Homelabarr Backend. Not recommended to change.
